payload.title: P4 Agents read the resolved guidelines (context pack, editorial context, skills)
payload.description:
What: every agent and tool gets guidelines from the one resolver, after its fixed base prompt.

Files:
- src/papyrus_content/newsroom_context_pack.py: new core layer writing_guidelines (copywriter: in full, before editorial_policies; editor: voice, audience, constraints only); visual_style resolves the section document; voice_examples reads exemplars first; layers record slug/version/hash
- src/papyrus_content/images/prompt_lint.py: extend to the role text in newsroom_context_pack.py (no publication-specific wording in code)
- src/papyrus_content/editorial_context.py and amplify/functions/shared/editorial-context.ts: entries writing-guidelines and visual-style at publication and section scope with lineage, version and sha256 (assignment-action picks them up)
- .agents/skills/copywriting/SKILL.md, skills/image-work/SKILL.md: read resolved guidelines first; no site wording
- docs/newsroom-context-packs.md
- features_backend/newsroom-context-pack.feature, features_backend/editorial-context.feature (new scenarios)

Acceptance checks:
- The role text always comes before the site's guidelines and is unchanged by any document (add-only).
- writing_guidelines and visual_style are core and never shed under the budget.
- papyrus assignments context-pack --story L --profile copywriter shows the section's writing guidelines with their sources.

Gherkin scenarios:
- The copywriter's pack holds the section's resolved writing guidelines after its role text
- The editor's pack holds only the voice, audience and binding rules
- A site's guidelines cannot replace the fixed role text
- Writing guidelines are never shed when the pack is over budget
- Editorial context lists writing and image guidelines with their versions and hashes
- A pack built for a site with no writing guidelines carries the missing warning

Design: docs/plans/guidelines-as-data.md. Gherkin specs are required and ship in the same PR. Text lives in S3, never inline in DynamoDB; no new GSI; no subscriptions. Style and voice wording is data, never code.
